drivers.name: Python
drivers.desc: Instale pelo PyPI: o wheel já traz o motor nativo para macOS (Apple Silicon), Linux x64 e Windows x64 — sem build, sem configuração.
drivers.code:
import tmjlite

db = tmjlite.connect_shared("app.tmjp")          # thread-safe, MVCC
st = db.prepare("INSERT INTO rs (ns, k, samples) VALUES (?, ?, ?) "
                "ON CONFLICT (ns, k) DO UPDATE SET samples = excluded.samples;")
with db.transaction():                           # um commit para o lote
    for it in lote:
        st.execute([it.ns, it.k, it.samples])
with db.cursor("SELECT samples FROM rs WHERE ns = ?", ["ns3"]) as cur:
    total = sum(row["samples"] for row in cur)   # streaming: memória O(1 linha)

drivers.code:
import tmjlite "github.com/TMJacometti/tmjlite"

db, _ := tmjlite.OpenShared("app.tmjp")          // goroutine-safe, MVCC
st, _ := db.Prepare("INSERT INTO rs (ns, k, samples) VALUES (?, ?, ?) ON CONFLICT (ns, k) DO UPDATE SET samples = excluded.samples;")
runtime.LockOSThread(); db.Begin()               // um commit para o lote
for _, it := range lote { st.Exec(it.NS, it.K, it.Samples) }
db.Commit(); runtime.UnlockOSThread()
cur, _ := db.Cursor("SELECT samples FROM rs WHERE ns = ?", "ns3")
defer cur.Close()
for cur.Next() { total += cur.Row().GetInt("samples") }   // streaming: O(1 linha)
